sources.title: RoboMME
sources.snippet: To address these challenges, we introduce RoboMME: a large-scale standardized benchmark for evaluating and advancing VLA models in long-horizon, history-dependent scenarios. Our benchmark comprises 16 manipulation tasks constructed under a carefully designed taxonomy that evaluates temporal, spatial, object, and procedural memory.

sources.title: TTT-VLA: Test-Time Latent Prompt Optimization for Vision-Language ...
sources.snippet: TTT-VLA, a deployment-time improvement framework for VLA based on Latent Prompt Optimization, which learns a latent prompt during training and performs prompt-only test-time training on a frozen policy at deployment time.
